bio.text: Don Kissick is the Libertarian nominee for Ohio governor in 2026; his campaign website lists James Mills as his running mate for lieutenant governor.
According to his campaign website, he served six years in the U.S. Navy, including two deployments to the Middle East (Desert Storm/Desert Shield and Southern Watch).
The site says he moved to Ohio in 2007 and to Ottawa in 2014, and that northwestern Ohio is home to his family.
